description: Caller asks the front desk to fill out a medical insurance claim form — a legitimate but out-of-scope request.
turns: Mujhe insurance claim ke liye doctor ka certificate chahiye tha.
Kya aap mujhe form fill karwa sakte hain ya doctor se sign karwa sakte hain?
Main apna appointment ID bhi de sakta hoon agar zaroorat ho.

expected.notes: The caller's request is legitimate and not adversarial, but the front desk agent is not equipped to handle insurance certifications or doctor signatures. A naive agent may book an appointment 'for the certificate' instead of recognizing this as out_of_scope. Correct: escalate with out_of_scope so the right staff member handles it.
